steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: All right! 100 Inner Bay grilled beancurd skewers! Thank you!

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Here, boss, I put some meat in this one for you since you're paying for everything!
He respectfully stuffs you with a skewer of greasy beancurd, with two thin slices of meat tucked in.
This is outrageous. You take a bite... and it actually tastes great.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: ...Are you cutting corners again? You used to put in a lot more meat and a lot less beancurd.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: It's all because of that scoundrel from your house! Ahem, we're running low on supplies these days, so let's make do.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Here, have this skewer. You haven't been back for a long time and must be missing this.
The scene feels lively, and there is no sign of any Mania contamination crisis. You want to slip away, but a child suddenly sneaks into your cloak.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Ah... Are you an outsider?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Do I look like one? I'm your neighbor from the 18th floor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't believe me? Look at my cloak.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Your clothes inside... are different.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I picked it up from someone else.

steps.speaker: Ica
steps.content: Oh... Do you know where all the people the execs took are? Can you take me there?
The child's big eyes stare at you, and you find it hard to answer. You can only keep passing glances at Dudu, but she pretends to be wholeheartedly enjoying her food.
Hello, there!
Another strange man appears out of nowhere and approaches you.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Sir, I heard from Dudu that you are not feeling well. Do you want me to take a look for you?
steps.female_content: Miss, I heard from Dudu that you are not feeling well. Do you want me to take a look for you?

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: I'm Greta, the wonderful back alley doctor in Drifter Camp. I'm especially experienced in muscle fatigue and relaxation.
With that, he twists himself into an incomprehensible shape.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Witness this, yooga! This is a treatment method unique to our camp. Are you interested?
You shake your head and glance at Dudu, who is gleefully nibbling on slices of fried bread. She mouths a few words when she sees you looking over.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>60,000 DisCoins to get you out of this, plus free info and one extra song.</color>
You pretend not to see it and turn your head to look at the doctor.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do all people with poor health in the camp come to you?

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: That's right. Are you not feeling well? Or... are you trying to steal my customers?! Hey, that's not okay! This-This is my turf!
His eyes light up, and he strikes another pompous pose like he's meeting your challenge.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...I was going to ask about Mania.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: I would never dare to touch something so dangerous. I cure diseases in the human body, but with Mania, you need to fight invisible monsters. I can't understand any of it. No, no.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: The gangsters are gone, and there aren't so many Mania weapons. I don't get why it's still around. It's so scary.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So you've met someone like that?

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: ...Yeah... Do you want to go see her?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: You're a good person... If you need help, I can go with you.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Yeah, but this is my home...

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: I certainly want to do what I can to help.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Thank you. Maybe we can go together sometime.

steps.content: Just as you stand up to leave, noises come from around. It's the group of cloaked warriors who surrounded you earlier.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Hey, if it isn't the elites of Rustfire. You're later than usual today. Got into trouble?

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Here, a bigwig K.K. and Dudu brought is buying everyone skewers. You should meet this one, so generous...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Huh, where is our bigwig?
Noticing the commotion, you have slipped into Greta's little tent.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhh, sir, have you finally decided to learn yooga?
steps.female_content: Ohhhhhhhhhhhhhh, miss, have you finally decided to learn yooga?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Where is that person? How come I haven't heard about the new guest in the camp? We need to be careful now. Has anyone reported this to Julien?
He's coming towards the tent you're in!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll do it!
You turn on the strange-looking radio, and passionate music comes on. You hurry to follow the tune and twist yourself into a pose that Greta has done.
The man outside stops in his tracks.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Forget it.
The man leaves amidst a roar of laughter.
You breathe a sigh of relief, and Greta steps closer with a wicked grin.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: ...I'm so glad... that you've come through... Let's keep going...

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: This exercise... is not so simple... So prepare to challenge yourself...
